_comment: Physical constants and model thresholds. Edit here, never in the Python code.
_emr_source: NASA Standard Breakup Model: impact energy-to-target-mass ratio above 40 J/g fragments the whole satellite.
_vaporization_source: Approx. heat to melt + boil + vaporize aluminium starting at 300 K (~13 MJ/kg).
_hypervelocity_source: Above ~3 km/s impact pressures exceed material strength: projectile behaves like a fluid.
